import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source3_29_0 and Source3_29_1 on "city"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source3_29_0.city, Source3_29_0.type
# Aggregations:
#   sum(Source3_29_0.driver_count)  -> driver_count (int)
#   avg(Source3_29_1.fare)          -> Average Fare (float)
#   count(Source3_29_1.ride_id)     -> Ride Count (int)

grouped = df_joined.groupby(['city', 'type'], as_index=False).agg({
    'driver_count': 'sum',
    'fare': 'mean',
    'ride_id': 'count'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
grouped.rename(columns={
    'fare': 'Average Fare',
    'ride_id': 'Ride Count'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema:
# city: string (object)
grouped['city'] = grouped['city'].astype(str)
# driver_count: integer
grouped['driver_count'] = grouped['driver_count'].astype(int)
# type: string (object)
grouped['type'] = grouped['type'].astype(str)
# Average Fare: float
grouped['Average Fare'] = grouped['Average Fare'].astype(float)
# Ride Count: integer
grouped['Ride Count'] = grouped['Ride Count'].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema order
final_df = grouped[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'Average Fare', 'Ride Count']]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/target_multisource.csv"
final_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_29/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float unique columns in target)
# Aggregations: average fare, count of ride_id
agg = joined.groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False).agg(
    Average_Fare=('fare', 'mean'),
    Ride_Count=('ride_id', 'count')
)

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
agg.rename(columns={'Average_Fare': 'Average Fare', 'Ride_Count': 'Ride Count'}, inplace=True)

# Write output to target file
